dogecoin.text: while tweet volume influences Litecoin and XRP prices. Another study from 2021 showed that Dogecoin returns were strongly tied to Twitter engagement, especially after high-profile tweets from figures like @elonmusk
A single tweet from an influencer like Elon Musk can send Dogecoin soaring (or crashing), as seen in February 2021 when Musk called it "the people's crypto," leading to a 50% price surge in hours
